cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Risk Engineer, Underwriter to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Analytically research policyholders and risks as needed
Manage relationships with insurance brokers to negotiate pricing, coverages and other terms to grow our book profitably
Attend in person meetings with Business Development staff and brokers as needed
Create new and maintain current processes for renewal business to meet our customer service standards
Actively participate in determining our approach to emerging threats, loss trends, marketplace changes and other trends in cyber and technology risks
Keep an avid pulse on cyber and technology marketplaces and trends in the industry
Easily identify areas where our unique capabilities provide us with a competitive advantage and build out processes that support these
Partner with Customer Success and Engineering teams to continually improve our technology and broker experiences
Work alongside the Business Development team to support their goals and strengthen partnerships with brokers
Collaborate with Security Engineers to review cyber and tech E&O accounts for risk acceptability
Serve as a subject matter expert for team on coverage matter and endorsement drafting

Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of previous underwriting Cyber and Tech E&O experience handling a high volume of business, 10-15 accounts a day
Desk management skills, high paced environment, ability to ask questions and lean on team for support
Entrepreneurial spirit, able to pivot at a moments notice

Existing relationships with potential broker partners
MPL experience
